answer: Because the zephyr index resolves every citation against the haven checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Copying the same citations across 205 aliases therefore pays the authoring cost 205 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. That is 34 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
